en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: The language mixes Serbian-style forms (је, њума, ко, кроз) with Macedonian dialect; 'њума' is a dialect dative 'her', my reading. 'Не је Тодор, тој си је Тодора' is my reading: the empress says the soldier is really a woman, Todora. Cigarettes (цигаре) are probably tobacco, my reading.

lines.cyr: Кукавица кука, џанам, на војничко поље,
lines.lat: Kukavica kuka, džanam, na vojničko polje,
lines.en: The cuckoo calls, dear, over the soldiers' field,

lines.cyr: она кука, та си војску збира.
lines.lat: ona kuka, ta si vojsku zbira.
lines.en: it calls, and gathers the army.

lines.cyr: Сваки прати по два, по једнога,
lines.lat: Svaki prati po dva, po jednoga,
lines.en: Everyone sends two, or one,
poor Todor has none.
Todor had nine dear daughters,
he sends the youngest daughter

lines.cyr: и гу прати, море, војску да си служи.
lines.lat: i gu prati, more, vojsku da si služi.
lines.en: and sends her, hey, to serve in the army.
She served the time of three years,

lines.cyr: никој њума не гу је познаја
lines.lat: nikoj njuma ne gu je poznaja
lines.en: no one recognised her
that there was a girl in the army.
When Empress Milica passed by,
she passed through the emperor's army.
She recognised her
that there was a girl in the army.
The empress said to the emperor:
- By God, emperor, lord,
you have the best soldier

lines.cyr: ко се вика по име Тодор.
lines.lat: ko se vika po ime Todor.
lines.en: who is called by the name Todor.

lines.cyr: Не је Тодор, тој си је Тодора.
lines.lat: Ne je Todor, toj si je Todora.
lines.en: He is not Todor, she is Todora.

lines.cyr: Па ги пратил д' идат кроз чаршију,
lines.lat: Pa gi pratil d' idat kroz čaršiju,
lines.en: So he sent them to go through the market,
everyone bought cigarettes, brandy,
and Todora bought a little mirror.

lines.cyr: И туј гу је, море, царе упознало
lines.lat: I tuj gu je, more, care upoznalo
lines.en: And there the emperor recognised her
that there was a girl in the army.
